description: XRISM Resolve total observed FWHM at 3.55 keV from the Gaussian forward model. Instrument response sigma_inst = 5.0 eV / 2.355 ~ 2.12 eV (Ishisaki et al. 2022, Resolve calibration); kinematic Doppler sigma_kin = E_obs * (v_turb / c) with E_obs ~ 3547.5 eV (post grav-redshift) and v_turb ~ 300 km/s gives sigma_kin ~ 3.55 eV (this is a Gaussian sigma, not a FWHM). Quadrature sum sigma_total = sqrt(sigma_inst^2 + sigma_kin^2) ~ 4.14 eV; converting back to FWHM via 2.355 * sigma_total yields predicted total observed FWHM ~9.75 eV. Intrinsic width is open (V3 Ch11 §11.2.3); narrow (<<1 eV, contributing negligibly to the quadrature sum) only if the emitters are lattice-bound. The 9.75 eV total is therefore the conditional lattice-bound branch and is not enforced. The deconvolved intrinsic line-width residual W_int observable is embedded in the full Protocol C preregistration: terminal no-line non-detection at the Bulbul-level empirical-derived floor Gamma <= 2.0e-28 s^-1 in >=94 Ms equivalent stacked exposure, W_int > 20 eV after instrument and registered kinematic/turbulence deconvolution, or morphology failing the stress-gated rho_above_sigma_crit^2 template by Delta chi^2 >= 9 versus both smooth rho and smooth rho^2 inside the sigma_crit = 0.53 keV cm^-3 frozen aperture falsifies. The 26 Ms / Gamma <= 3.8e-28 s^-1 stack remains a morphology-linewidth milestone; the background-limited Gamma <= 1.2e-30 s^-1 calculation is theoretical, not operative. Engine target here is the total convolved FWHM as predicted by the forward model.
